theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_invariant_planar_support
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → IsConeCurrent S ∧ (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) ∧ ∃ S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), IsMinimizingIn S₀ univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S₀ ∧ IsConeCurrent S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)) → (∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ), (0 < m → ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {e}, HasMassDensity C y m) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), n ≤ P → Module.finrank ℝ L + 1 = n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ S.support ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))
